definitions.explanation: A violent weather condition combining strong winds and heavy rain.

examples.japanese: {暴風雨|ぼうふうう}が{近|ちか}づいている。
{暴風雨|ぼうふうう}で{電車|でんしゃ}が{止|と}まった。
examples.english: The trains stopped due to the storm.

examples.japanese: {暴風雨|ぼうふうう}{警報|けいほう}が{発令|はつれい}された。

notes:
{暴風雨|ぼうふうう} is a compound of {暴風|ぼうふう} (violent wind) + {雨|う} (rain), describing severe weather with both strong winds and heavy rain.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暴風雨|ぼうふうう}{警報|けいほう}: storm warning
- {暴風雨|ぼうふうう}に{見舞|みま}われる: to be hit by a storm
- {暴風雨|ぼうふうう}が{去|さ}る: the storm passes
- {暴風雨|ぼうふうう}が{近|ちか}づく: a storm approaches

RELATED WORDS:
- {暴風|ぼうふう}: violent wind, gale (wind only)
- {台風|たいふう}: typhoon (specific weather system)
- {嵐|あらし}: storm (more general, also used figuratively)
- {豪雨|ごうう}: heavy rain (rain only)
- {暴風雪|ぼうふうせつ}: blizzard (wind + snow)

PRONUNCIATION:
Note the three consecutive う sounds: ぼう・ふう・う.
